anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Neither output runs the bounded watch: Before has no watch concept at all, and After explicitly declines to fire it ("No prior report has been rendered in this run, so this is the first report, and no wait was picked. No watch runs") and then puts `wait` at row 1 before any window has elapsed. The gap is that the Change gates the watch on "after the first report" and After interprets a resumed same-run entry as a fresh first report because no report was rendered in this process, even though the record carries a non-null assessed_head, findings and evidence from a report that already rendered. To deliver the Change on resumed entries while keeping everything Before kept, say explicitly that a validated continuation record with assessed_head set counts as having rendered the first report; then on the pre-menu refresh, when Blockers are empty and a binding check is pending with no held grant, run exactly one bounded `gh pr checks --watch` (timeout from configuration, stamped as poll_deadline) without a pick, re-resolve evidence from its result, and only when the window expires without a conclusion render the pending report with `wait` as row 1. Keep the no-local-run, no-claim-helper and no-merge-recommendation lines unchanged, and keep the genuine first-in-run report (no record, no prior render) as the only case that skips the watch.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After moves f6 from fails to holds: step 4 explicitly runs one bounded `gh pr checks 642 --watch` under a persisted 15-minute `poll_deadline` with no `wait` pick, because Blockers are empty on this same-run re-entry, and only after the window expires does the menu offer `wait` as row 1 ("start a new bounded CI watch"). Before instead refused to watch at all ("I do not poll, sleep, or start a poll deadline: no wait was selected") and asked for `wait` immediately, so it failed the fact. Keep the After wording that ties the pre-menu watch guard to 'Blockers empty' rather than to a prior `wait` selection or a repair grant, and keep the explicit statement that the watch's exit code is not used for readiness and that the full refresh (PR view, run list, comments) is repeated once after expiry; that combination delivers the Change without introducing polling into the fix loop or into the first report.
